category_edits.rationale: Apply exponential recency weighting to valid next-item losses across all four datasets, retaining the existing detached negative-score weighting. Normalize recency weights to mean one over valid targets. This emphasizes recent transitions without changing the GRU, sampling, optimizer, schedule, or inference.

edits.find:
valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()
edits.replace:
valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    positions = torch.arange(pos.size(1), device=pos.device).unsqueeze(0).expand_as(pos)
    latest = positions.masked_fill(~mask, -1).max(dim=1, keepdim=True).values
    distances = (latest - positions).clamp_min(0)
    recency_weights = torch.exp(-distances[mask].to(valid_pos.dtype) / 20.0)
    recency_weights = recency_weights / recency_weights.mean()
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * recency_weights * pairwise_loss).sum()
